pure_kl_fresh_adam: rescale whole parameter delta to fresh base-Adam L2 norm before step fractions
projection_metric: raw latent Euclidean metric; exact rowspace/nullspace of frozen standardized pooled anchor map
repair_target: remove half the smaller of raw visible and null error energy, equally in the two repairs
reader: immutable original BF16 model with cached teacher action target and same sampler seed; no VideoDiT generation
selection: No checkpoint or hyperparameter selection. Every declared C8 case and probe retained, including failed descent and imperfect finite-step predictions.
interpretation: Weight evidence requires paired actual base/action descent at reduced beta; finite-step evidence compares surrogate g-dot-delta with actual quantized loss and both step sizes; direction evidence uses KL-only probes plus equal-NMSE BF16 reader repairs and reader latent gradients. Several causes may coexist; C8 local evidence cannot establish heldout or closedloop causality.
